introduction: 11队选手从上海陆家嘴出发，踏上一场冲刺中国的征途。为总价值40万的穿越可可西里挑战资格以及环球之旅展开激烈争夺。The Amazing Race: China Rush 2 is a Chinese reality television series. Based on the American reality TV series, The Amazing Race, it features 11 teams of two, each with a pre-existing relationship, in a race across 11 cities in China to win a trip to Hoh Xil Natural Reserve worth ¥400,000
